In order to try and align the interest of shareholders and senior management of a company, _________ are often made available to _______ of a company, to ensure that it is in their interests to increase _______ and dividend performance.
Option A: Share options, Senior managers, Share Price
Option B: Share options, All employees, Share Price
Option C: Non-financial remunerations, Senior managers, Employee Satisfaction
Option D: Non-financial remunerations, All employees, Employee Satisfaction
